reason: In src/sentry/api/paginator.py:182, BasePaginator.get_result clamps the offset only for non-prev cursors, and every subclass inherits this. build_cursor (utils/cursors.py:116,141,187) still computes the next cursor from the raw negative offset (e.g. -5+limit), so pages overlap. Prev cursors such as 0:-5:1 still pass a negative slice to Django, which raises a ValueError that base.py:540 does not catch, so the comment saying the queryset handles boundary conditions is false. Minor correction: line 192 only runs for prev cursors, where the offset is never clamped, so that line itself is not inconsistent.
